# dotted-identifier: fully qualified module, class and symbol paths in code, configuration and logs.
# a dotted path is a name. it is long and mixed-case, but it is not an opaque token.
# a dotted name whose every segment is CamelCase, with no lower-case or snake_case
# segment to anchor it, is recognized as words too, not reported as an opaque value.

# one separator between two camelCase segments reads as a dotted field path.

field = "sessionPayload.workspaceFolderPath"
# a framework symbol opens with its prefix of capitals or a hungarian `k` (`NS`, `CGS`, `kCF`).
# `org` and `co` are recognized now, so a reverse domain name carrying only those short
# labels is not reported.
# known gap: a reverse domain name with a short label outside the vocabulary, such as `cs`
# (`identifier = "uk.cs.example.billing.ledger-export"`), is still reported. a label of two
# or three letters cannot be told from a chunk of a token, and a random dotted lowercase
# token passes a rule that admits one such label more than 2% of the time.
